resources.string: A reader for books, comics and manga that helps you learn languages.
EPUB, PDF, FB2, MOBI, DOCX, TXT, CBZ/CBR and image folders
Tap a word for the dictionary, translate sentences and repeat saved words
Find books and manga in OPDS catalogs and online sources
Fix books and comics in the built-in editor
Choose a folder: Yomu adds the books from it and keeps the library up to date.
You can skip this step and import single files from the library later.
Words and sentences you look up will be translated into this language. You can change it in the settings.
The app crashed last time. The report has the error, the screen it happened on and the phone model: send it to the developer to get it fixed. Nothing is sent without you.

string-array.name: whats_new_2_1_1
string-array.item: Continue reading opens the next chapter, and YouTube titles offer online listening again.
The audiobook player has chapter navigation, bookmarks, configurable skip intervals and an improved sleep timer.
A simpler profile puts statistics and tracking within reach.
Manage downloads from the library, with clearer progress and more resilient transfers.

string-array.name: whats_new_2_1_0
string-array.item: Audiobooks: your own files and folders, LibriVox, podcasts and YouTube videos, playlists and channels, with chapters, speed, skip silence and a sleep timer.
Search YouTube right from "Audiobook by link" or the catalog, and download online audiobooks to listen offline.
Playback recovers by itself after losing the connection and resumes a few seconds earlier after a pause.
Sync to GitHub with a switch per category, and a new Notifications section in Settings.

string-array.name: whats_new_2_0_6
string-array.item: MangaUpdates tracking: sign in with your username, search, bind titles, sync chapters and rating. Imported from Mihon backups too.
PDF reflow now reads two-column pages in the right order, drops page numbers and rebuilds paragraphs.
Kitsu keeps the privacy flag of your entries and sends start/finish dates.

string-array.name: whats_new_2_0_5
string-array.item: Sync conflicts are resolved in the app: changed book files, image folders and their pages, book deletions — changed copies are kept until you choose.
Legacy image folders migrate to stable identities; pages can be replaced, added or removed with a visible report.
Book deletions now follow the sync between devices; server files are never deleted automatically.

string-array.name: whats_new_2_0_4
string-array.item: Local books and manga files can now be linked to AniList, MyAnimeList and Shikimori. Set chapters manually; local page progress is not sent automatically.
Backups with files now include books downloaded through WebDAV sync.

string-array.name: whats_new_2_0_3
string-array.item: Optional WebDAV book file sync: enable it on each device under Backup and sync. The server can read the files; local deletions may be restored and image folders are not supported.

string-array.name: whats_new_2_0_2
string-array.item: Interrupted update downloads resume when the release has a checksum; the APK package and signing certificate are checked before opening the installer.
A damaged sync file is no longer overwritten.
Encrypted EPUB books now show an unsupported-format error instead of opening as unreadable text.

string-array.name: whats_new_2_0_1
string-array.item: Profile: new Tracking and Downloads tabs. Tracking lists every title linked to MyAnimeList, AniList or Shikimori with its status, chapters and score, refreshes them all at once and sends the changes that wait.
Shikimori fixed: the service moved to shikimori.io, and requests sent to the old address lost the sign-in.
More reliable tracking: requests made at the same time no longer break the sign-in, a server error no longer signs you out, and changes made while signed out are sent as soon as you sign in.
WebDAV sync also works with servers that compress files on the fly.
Editing the metadata of several books no longer touches a language you left as it was.

string-array.name: whats_new_2_0_0
string-array.item: Moving from Mihon or Tachiyomi? Settings → Backup and sync → Import from Mihon / Tachiyomi brings your library, categories, read chapters and tracking from a .tachibk backup.
Tracking with Shikimori, AniList and MyAnimeList: link a title with the Tracking button on its page, and the chapters you read go to your list by themselves.
Light novels online: novel sources (RanobeLib, NovelBin) in the catalog, chapters open in the book reader.
A “Continue reading” widget for the home screen.
Manga editor: “Translate page (OCR)” recognizes the text of a page, translates it and letters it into the image; every bubble can be corrected.
Book editor: edit a chapter as it looks, without HTML, and translate only the chapters you choose.
Library: select several books and edit their authors, series, tags and status at once.
PDF highlights are also saved in the file itself, so other PDF apps show them (Manga and PDF settings).
Sync through a shared folder or WebDAV: deletions and the online library are synced too, on its own if you like. Update every synced device to 2.0.
Long-press menus: radial or a list, with the actions and order you choose (Settings → Long-press menus).

string-array.name: whats_new_1_9_0
string-array.item: Switching tabs is smooth: a tab you opened stays ready in the background, so coming back to it no longer rebuilds the whole screen, and a tab starts loading as soon as your finger touches the bar.
Fixed: the app closed when a title page in the catalog failed to load.
After a crash, Yomu offers to send or copy the report on the next start: the error, the screen it happened on and the steps before it.
Sources with a source per language (MangaDex, Wikisource, NHentai and others): switch the language right in the top bar of the source, with your search and filters.

string-array.name: whats_new_1_8_0
string-array.item: A Profile tab instead of History: reading time, streaks, milestones, statistics and history in one place, with a shareable card.
The bottom bar floats over the content without a background strip: lists scroll underneath it.
Catalog: filters for the source list (languages, content, type, 18+, pinned), kept after a restart. The catalog opens without the freeze.
Source filters: tags that load in the background appear by themselves, Reset always works, and long tag lists no longer slow the panel down.
The manga tap zones are no longer shown every time a title opens (reading settings → Show tap zones on opening).

string-array.name: whats_new_1_7_0
string-array.item: Seven app icons to choose from in Settings → Appearance → App icon, themed on Android 13 and newer.
Updates inside the app: About → Check for updates downloads the APK for your phone, verifies its checksum and opens the installer.
With the daily check on, a dot on Settings and a card at the top of the settings tell you about a new version.
This list, once after every update.
